description: Legacy vocabulary that the compiler must recognise so that it can reject it with a precise 'obsolete' diagnostic instead of reporting it as an unknown feature. Entries here are never implemented: an obsolete element or attribute is always a compilation error in strict mode. The list complements CompilerKnowledge/Vocabulary/DeprecatedElements.json, which is mined from the current revision of the reference and therefore cannot mention features the reference no longer documents.
